sentences.en: In those days, a new type of democracy was rising.
sentences.zh: 在那个时代，一种新的民主形式正在兴起。

sentences.en: Far from falling, the prices of commodities went on rising.
sentences.zh: 商品价格不但没有下跌，反而持续上涨。

sentences.en: Getting up early tomorrow, you will see the rising sun.
sentences.zh: 明天早起，你就能看到冉冉升起的太阳。
